topic.title: Days in Month Calculator
topic.description: Determines the number of days in any given month for any year, accounting correctly for leap years. Combines function design with list indexing.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Encapsulating leap year logic in a helper function and using a list of month-day counts indexed by month number.
learningNotes.challenges: Correctly adjusting February days when the year is a leap year.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Extend to calculate the number of days between two dates.

files.description: Returns days in a month with leap year support.
